scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.db:rbac: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not $env:DIRECT_URL -and (Test-Path .env)) { Get-Content .env | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^DIRECT_URL="?(.*)"?$') { $env:DIRECT_URL = $matches[1] } } }; if (-not $env:DIRECT_URL) { throw 'DIRECT_URL is required' }; psql $env:DIRECT_URL -f ops/rbac.sql"
scripts.db:rbac:defaults: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not $env:DIRECT_URL -and (Test-Path .env)) { Get-Content .env | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^DIRECT_URL="?(.*)"?$') { $env:DIRECT_URL = $matches[1] } } }; if (-not $env:DIRECT_URL) { throw 'DIRECT_URL is required' }; psql $env:DIRECT_URL -f ops/rbac-default-privileges.sql"
